مُقَلَّدٌ The place of the قِلَادَة [or necklace, or collar, upon the neck]; (K;) [the neck of a woman, and of a horse, &c.]. ―
-b2- The place of the suspensory belt or cord of the sword, upon the shoulders. (S, K.) ―
-b3- [Having a قِلَادَة or the like put upon his neck]. ―
-b4- A horse which outstrips others, (S, L, K,) which has something put upon his neck in order that it may be known that he has outstripped. (S, L.) ―
-b5- A chief upon whom are imposed the affairs of his people. (Ham p. 127.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
